default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1158.title: Prior clock-hour high/low break
E-1158.hypothesis: Stops and breakout orders cluster beyond the previous clock hour's extremes; a first close beyond them releases that flow in the break direction.

E-1159.title: Floor-pivot reclaim after a hold
E-1159.hypothesis: The classic pivot (H+L+C)/3 of yesterday is watched by many; after bars spent on one side, a close across it shifts control and should follow.

E-1160.title: Pin bar at a window extreme
E-1160.hypothesis: A large bar that probes a fresh window low (high) and closes with a long wick shows aggressive sellers (buyers) absorbed; fade into the wick.

E-1161.title: Narrowest-bar break
E-1161.hypothesis: The narrowest bar of the last n bars marks a pause in participation; a close beyond its range restarts directional flow.

E-1162.title: Signed-volume divergence fade
E-1162.hypothesis: A fresh window high reached while signed volume is net selling means buying is thin and sellers are absorbing; fade the extreme (and mirror).

E-1164.title: Daily range budget exhaustion fade
E-1164.hypothesis: Once the session range reaches a share of the 5-session average daily range, new extremes meet profit-taking; fade a reversal-colored bar at the extreme.

E-1165.title: Close-location thrust follow
E-1165.hypothesis: A bar with above-typical range and volume closing at its very high (low) shows one side in full control through the close; follow it.

E-1166.title: Gap-side day-open bounce
E-1166.hypothesis: On a gap day, the day's opening price is the level where gap holders defend; a dip to it that closes back on the gap side is a continuation entry.

E-1167.title: Two-step volume ramp follow
E-1167.hypothesis: Volume rising bar after bar in one direction signals a crowd entering; the bar's color shows who is pressing, so follow it.
